dialogs.about: 손자와 나란히 앉아 옛날 이야기를 해요

lines.en: Grandma, why do you use a cane now?
My knee is a little stiff these days.
Does it hurt when you walk?
No, not much. The cane helps my joints.
lines.ko: 아니요, 많이는 아니에요. 지팡이가 관절을 도와줘요.

lines.en: Grandma, can you recall your school days?
Yes. I walked to school every morning back then.
lines.ko: 네. 그때는 매일 아침 학교까지 걸어갔어요.

lines.en: Wow. Are you forgetful now?
A little, but my hearing is still good.
lines.ko: 조금요, 그래도 귀는 아직 잘 들려요.

lines.en: Good. I will walk with you every evening.
Thank you. That will make me strong.
Good morning. How are your knees today?
Better, thank you. They were stiff last winter.
Aging is not easy, but you look well.
lines.ko: 나이 드는 게 쉽지 않은데, 좋아 보이세요.

lines.en: You too. Is your hearing okay?
Yes, but I am forgetful about names.
Me too. I can't recall my neighbor's name.
lines.ko: 저도요. 이웃 이름이 기억이 안 나요.

lines.en: The class for older people helps. Did you go?
lines.ko: 어르신 교실이 도움이 돼요. 가 보셨어요?

lines.en: No, never. Is it hard on stiff joints?
lines.ko: 아니요, 한 번도요. 뻣뻣한 관절에 힘들까요?

lines.en: No. People in wheelchairs come too.
Then I will go with you next week.
